verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents substantial API coverage of core recruiting actions: updating candidate information, adding attachments, and advancing, moving and rejecting applications. It also offers a Job Board API, candidate-ingestion and assessment partner APIs, and webhooks for application and candidate lifecycle events. Nothing shows that these APIs match the full UI surface: reporting, AI notetaker, Voice AI, Talent Matching, onboarding, CRM outreach and job-board building appear only as UI features. Missing for 10: any explicit API-parity claim, API coverage of reporting/analytics, AI features, onboarding and CRM/outreach, and independent or hands-on corroboration of breadth.
